_comment: 'What's Included' bullets per website slug → products.included_features (JSONB array of strings). Sourced from brellohealth.com's product pages on 2026-07-15. The pattern is a per-product medication line (or lines, for bundles) followed by six shared service bullets: syringes+instructions, Brello App, Brello Rise, Private Community, Provider Health Review, Fast Shipping. Single-medication products list their one medication '(If Approved)'; bundle products list each medication in the stack. generate-product-included-features-sql.mjs turns these into idempotent UPDATEs that set ONLY included_features, tenant- and uuid-scoped per env. compounded-nad/compounded-sermorelin/compounded-micc use the same 6 shared bullets with their own medication line. Parent bundle *pages* (glp-1-and-nad, glp-1-sermorelin-and-nad) are omitted — the platform sells only the per-medication variant products. To refresh: re-read each /product/ page's 'What's Included' section and update the arrays here.
